title: Icons between states
description: A menu, a playback symbol and an add action keep their identity while changing shape.
useCase: Connect the two states of an occasional icon action with continuous SVG geometry.
reducedMotion: Paths update immediately and rotation is removed.
limitations: These controls demonstrate local states. Connect their state to a real menu, player or item action in your application.
look: Light blue-grey page with three white rounded-square icon buttons in a row showing dark grey menu, play and plus glyphs.
motion: Pressing springs each icon's path data to its pair: menu crosses into close while turning 90°, play splits into pause bars, plus flattens to minus with a half turn.
adapt: `useIconMorph` picks shapes from `iconMorphPresets` and `normalize` pads them to equal path counts, collapsing spares to the centre; each `motion.path` animates `d` and the wrapper `rotate` with the `CELL` spring. Add your own `MorphShape` pairs with matching point counts per slot.
